goal.SRAM_scope: All simultaneously live estimator state, RAM-resident configuration, workspaces, acquisition/delivery buffers, checkpoint staging and attributable stack/runtime/interrupt use. Flash and external persistence measured separately.
requirements: Preserve actual intervals, order and physical state
Conditional indefinite-runtime stability remains a proof gate
goal.target_priority: Capacity absolute relative error <= 5% and current SOC absolute error <= 10 percentage points first; preferred <= 0.5% capacity and <= 0.5 percentage points SOC next. Gains below preferred have diminishing priority versus memory, processing and robustness. These are product point-error requirements, not local-covariance or coverage guarantees; no universal nuisance-parameter accuracy goal.

priority_change.now: M2/A4: one boundary-aware active-set gain successor after the first autonomous bounded candidate failed capacity accuracy and local qualification. Freeze the precise design and accounting, then repeat the same small harness once.
priority_change.former_next_action: Fixed partition of uncertain R/tau box
priority_change.former_action_status: Optional targeted remedy after a measured target-quality blocker; no longer the automatic next milestone
priority_change.frozen_evidence: All prior receipts, gates and failures unchanged, including three certificate004 usefulness failures, original M1 sparse-fit failure and the first A4 capacity/qualification failure.

reference_roles.full_C: Existing16-unknown three-RC/hysteresis retained-history estimator: M1 desktop baseline and selected short causal comparisons. Growing history is explicit; not the annual per-update engine.
reference_roles.certificate004: Restricted static one-uncertain-RC/hard-voltage lane and reusable numerical evidence. Original two-cell traces are outside this contract; no truth supplied to make them fit.

Functional/resource gates pass; capacity and provisional-error audit fail. Preserve as a rejected comparison, then test one bounded successor. No annual or target promotion.
reference_roles.truth: Generator/scorer only. No truth in initialization, correction, reset, attention, priors or inference checkpoint.
reference_roles.ultimate_performance: Best measured performance among declared candidates/scenarios, not a global-optimality or physical-coverage claim

milestones.name: Two-cell end-to-end desktop demonstration
milestones.scope: One existing seed per cell,35minutes each, no-attention full C baseline. Lifecycle correctness and useful-target reporting; not bounded firmware.

execution.fit_schedule_note: New sparse policy; compare restart with its own uninterrupted control. Old10-checkpoint warm-start results remain context, not a bitwise-equivalence target.
runs_per_cell: one paired run with warm restores after12s,1200s,1850s
one cold-reset branch at900s with at most2 later fits
execution.fault_checks: Small deterministic API probes without extra optimizations; no Cartesian sweep.
execution.estimator_prior: Public starts and preceding estimated theta as a start only; replayed observations do not also enter as a posterior prior.
execution.fit_budget_rule: Warm checkpoints retain complete fit/schedule state. Any recomputed scheduled fit counts against the same20-call cap; choose small replay probes accordingly.

required_behaviors: Initialize, ordered ingest, state advance, query with reason/freshness/uncertainty semantics
Complete versioned checkpoint and fresh-process restore with matching configuration/history identity
Warm restore replays known intervening inputs exactly once
Cold reset keeps plant running, drops unsupported knowledge explicitly and measures relearning
Duplicate/out-of-order delivery, corrupt/truncated/incompatible checkpoint and sequence exhaustion fail explicitly
Unknown-input gap returns recovery_required or an implemented valid uncertainty envelope; no invented zero current
Missing voltage never deletes known current/time propagation; unsupported backend handling is explicit

functional: Both input streams complete the declared lifecycle without silent corruption
Deterministic restored integer/serialized state and input ledger match uninterrupted control; floating numerical comparisons exclude timing and use tolerances frozen before results
No truth or duplicate evidence enters inference
Lost history, unsupported outputs and invalid assumptions remain visible
Every scheduled estimate records convergence, point error, uncertainty type, status and resource cost
usefulness: On informative suffix checkpoints report whether SOCerror<0.5percentage_points and Qrelative_error<0.5percent; these are inherited synthetic benchmark targets, not physical product guarantees
Evaluate retention during weak use and reacquisition after reset separately; unresolved nuisance parameters are acceptable
Functional and usefulness acceptance are separate booleans; usefulness failure prevents promotion of that estimator as the long-run candidate, not an honest lifecycle demonstration
gates.exit: Publish compact receipt, trajectory plot/report and a bounded list of blockers. Stop M1 once required functionality is demonstrated; choose one blocker to fix if usefulness fails.

milestones.proof_scope: Only new ordering, transaction, complete-state and restore obligations required for this integration; inherit existing proofs where their premises hold.

outcome.warm_continuation: Both cells: exact numerical query/fit and canonical checkpoint parity; timing fields excluded.
outcome.later_accuracy: Both control/warm cells meet original SOC/Q thresholds at 1800 s and 2100 s; both cold branches meet their two recovery checkpoints.
outcome.cold_unknown_period: Inference cleared at 900 s; no point before first scheduled post-reset fit at 1800 s. Plant/source position and absolute clock preserved.
outcome.promotion: M1 functional demonstration complete. The sparse full-reference schedule is not promoted as a long-run performance candidate.

milestones.name: Desktop performance and one-year trajectory campaign
entry: A chosen autonomous bounded candidate passes the same small harness hard target, lifecycle, resource and honest-qualification gates without truth parameters or growing history
Freeze candidate model/domain, resource budget, quality thresholds, seeds, reset schedule and logging budget
Classify which static/voltage/input assumptions support hard claims and which cases are mismatch diagnostics
steps: Freeze one boundary-aware active-set gain with matching full Joseph square-root update and complete memory/work account; deterministic update tests, then one unchanged two-cell falsification before further promotion
Small paired load/cell/noise matrix; choose one no-attention candidate
Optional one-policy attention comparison; keep only for predeclared practical benefit
Two selected365-day streams, one per cell, with predefined load/noise regimes and carried state

variation_matrix.cells: Existing two cells first; additional parameter differences only for a stated unresolved decision
variation_matrix.mismatch: Sensor bias, OCV error, temperature and parameter drift are separate declared plant variations. Static hard-bound claims do not carry over automatically. Do not call a static annual run aging validation.
variation_matrix.design: A few paired comparisons, not a full Cartesian product. Select annual scenarios by declared regime/stress coverage; freeze held-out annual noise seeds before scoring. Short screening selects algorithms and failure regimes, never seeds for favorable accuracy.

sizing.rule: Publish measured wall-time/output-size estimate before annual execution. Process actual intervals and chronology; faster wall-clock execution is allowed, sample skipping/closed-form fast-forward requires separate equivalence evidence.

milestones.storage_and_reference: Generate deterministically in chunks, keep bounded streaming metrics/checkpoints and failure excerpts with entering state; preserve seed/source/config hashes. Full retained-history C fits only selected short causal histories. A window reference declares missing prior history and independent entering-state treatment; no truth-seeded operational reference.
gates: Chosen candidate meets frozen hard capacity/SOC target, availability, uncertainty-qualification and resource gates; preferred 0.5%/0.5 pp performance reported separately
No unexplained numerical failure, state divergence after valid restore, chronology corruption or age-driven resource growth
Mismatch behavior and unresolved estimates reported honestly
Year evidence and all-prefix numerical proof ledger both reported; neither substitutes for the other
outputs: SOC/Q errors and uncertainty by regime
First and sustained convergence; fraction useful/unresolved/inconsistent
Reproducible failures and explicit claim boundaries

next_action.scope: One boundary-aware active-set gain successor. Let feasible coordinates learn when one nuisance correction points outward; retain full state/parameter covariance and exactly-once chronology.
design_before_run: Specify the finite active-set gain rule and mean-domain handling; no after-result parameter, prior, noise or threshold retuning
Derive a valid square-root implementation of the full Joseph covariance for the actual chosen gain; the old common-scalar factor formula is not automatically valid for component-dependent gain
Account for every simultaneously live state, workspace, immutable RAM config, staging, checkpoint and own-source stack cost, plus explicit unresolved target/runtime extras
State fixed source work per sample and meaningful deterministic numerical/boundary checks; no optional theorem or fault-campaign expansion
freeze_before_run: One successor source/plan and its gain, covariance, rejection and qualification semantics
Unchanged public priors, model, noise, observations, acquisition chronology and lifecycle/reset schedule
Unchanged hard target thresholds and the existing provisional hard-error audit, with preferred performance separate
Declared fixed storage/work budget and one same-harness replay with first-result preservation
next_action.measured_blocker: Cell B control/warm has 71,928 zero-gain updates in 73,500; a nuisance-bound outward correction makes the single common gain zero and also blocks feasible SOC/capacity correction.
next_action.independent_blocker: Wrong narrow local Gaussian capacity beliefs. Cell A cold finishes at -7.485014% capacity error with a provisional narrow interval, despite only 1,434 of 42,000 post-reset updates having zero gain. Gain-stall removal is not established as a cure.
next_action.experiment: Run the same two-cell control/warm/cold harness once after the design and tests are frozen. Preserve first outputs; compare hard target errors, availability/qualification, stalls and resources against first A4 and frozen M1.
next_action.finish_line: Keep/change/drop after one run. Promotion requires hard target, lifecycle/resource and honest-qualification gates. Fewer zero gains alone are insufficient. If a gate fails, stop and name one measured blocker; no automatic tuning, attention, variation or duration campaign.
guardrails: Preserve original M1 gates, first A4 source/plan and all failed outcomes
Keep synthetic truth out of initialization, gain design/tuning, inference, reset and scheduling
Carry earlier evidence through the chosen local approximation without replay/posterior double counting
Use the actual chosen gain consistently for mean and full Joseph covariance; no mean-only clipping or unearned covariance shrinkage
Local precision, actual point error, numerical health and validated coverage remain separate
Day/week/year follow only a qualified small-harness candidate; finite endurance is not an indefinite-runtime proof
Attention remains one optional decision experiment after plain-candidate qualification

immediate_actions.deliver: Freeze the small M1 API, sparse fit/fault schedule and numerical comparison tolerances while implementing the desktop adapter. One implementation-sized change; no new theory branch.
Implement complete pointer-free checkpoint/journal plus restore, cold reset and delivery/error semantics; add meaningful deterministic lifecycle tests.
Run the two selected cells and paired restart path, score only after inference, publish functional/usefulness statuses and a short blocker list.
immediate_actions.completion_note: One 20-fit primary campaign completed; functional acceptance true and usefulness false reported separately. Failure preserved; no retune or repeat.

immediate_actions.deliver: Qualify one autonomous bounded learner. First full-factor candidate is implemented and falsified; next specify/test one boundary-aware active-set gain with matching full Joseph covariance and complete accounting, then one unchanged small-harness run.

attention_decision.timing: Only after the plain bounded candidate qualifies on the small harness; optional practical-benefit decision before longer M2 campaigns
arms: Same candidate with no attention/regular work schedule
Existing sensitivity/event summary where model/chart compatible; retain full C as external comparison
attention_decision.fairness: Identical public priors, data/order, physical updates, reset schedule and fixed per-arm resource budget; report quality and cost. Freeze before held-out evaluation.
attention_decision.invariant: Every arm advances charge and dynamics on every actual interval. Evidence selection/weighting/compression requires its own validity and history semantics; no truth-guided selection or fabricated confidence.
attention_decision.stop: Keep attention only if it delivers the predeclared useful performance/CPU/memory benefit. Otherwise keep the simpler baseline; no automatic wider search.

research_rule.admission: Every proof/experiment names a milestone gate or algorithm decision it resolves. Safety/containment defects are blockers; a precision plateau is investigated only when it blocks declared target usefulness.
research_rule.loop: One concrete design, one small falsification, one keep/change/drop decision; expand only for a specific remaining question.
research_rule.preservation: Do not retune archived gates, reset ledgers, shrink domains around truth or rerun old campaigns merely to resume.
parking_lot: Uncertain-RC fixed partition absent a demonstrated target blocker
Universal identification of every nuisance parameter
Further theorem refinement beyond the chosen implementation/claim scope
research_rule.stop_after_failure: Preserve each first result and select one measured blocker. Active-set gain tests do not authorize prior/noise retuning, additional candidate sweeps, an uncertainty theorem expansion or day/week/year runs.

resolved_clarifications: Count repeated scheduled fits within20-call cap
Freeze held-out annual seeds before scoring; select scenarios by coverage, not favorable results
